name: Granola
description: Granola lets agents search and read meeting notes and transcripts in the signed-in Granola account. Each user signs in to their own Granola account through the browser.

prompts.text: Recap my meetings this week and the decisions we made.
Find my notes from the call where we discussed the hiring plan.
Draft a follow-up email from my last meeting notes.

apps.name: Granola
apps.description: Meeting note and transcript search, over Granola's MCP server with browser sign-in.
